First release of GlimStone — the shared design language behind a family of apps by the same author, extracted from KnightLoader and versioned independently ever since.

## ✨ Added

- Initial repository. Extracted the design language out of KnightLoader, where it had lived as `docs/design-language.md` + `web/src/index.css` + `web/src/lib/appearance.ts` since 2026-08-06, and merged it with the more complete rule set that had since evolved in the vault-only style guide (rules 9 through 19: three-way colour modes, section badges, content-edge alignment, everything-clickable-is-a-badge, borderless form fields, the window contract, hover-survives-hover, no forced `display`, replace-not-persuade, shared-box grouping).
- [`docs/design-language.md`](docs/design-language.md) — the full spec, all nineteen rules, the palette, the name's etymology, componentry (info bubble, horizontal selector, switches, the reveal eye, foreign-host-UI plugins, badges, toasts, empty states, destructive actions, charts), the shape/colour/motion engines, the type scale, the two user-owned axes (expanded to four: shape, accent, theme, language), RTL and non-Latin script coverage, the rainbow colour-mode system and its three known traps, the token contract, and the adoption steps.
- [`reference/tokens.css`](reference/tokens.css) — framework-free reference tokens and utility classes.
- [`reference/tailwind-theme.css`](reference/tailwind-theme.css) — the optional Tailwind v4 `@theme` mapping layer, split out from the framework-free tokens so a non-Tailwind app can skip it entirely.
- [`reference/appearance.ts`](reference/appearance.ts) — the shape/accent/rainbow logic, genericised so it drops into any adopting app unchanged.
- A banner (`.github/assets/`), generated procedurally: a faceted gold gem set into fractured stone (the name's own etymology drawn literally), replaced during development by the chosen mark — one lit block in a 3x3 grid of stone blocks, literal to this document's own opening line.
- AGPL-3.0 license (name and branding reserved, matching every other own-named product repo), `FUNDING.yml`, a License badge, and the Buy Me a Coffee button.

## 🎨 Design

- A full token reference table and an explicit utility-class list (`.glim-hue-icon`, `.glim-tint`, `.glim-page-enter`, `.glim-toast`, `.glim-fade`, `.glim-live`) alongside the written rules.
- Published for reference and transparency, not positioned as a general-purpose design system seeking outside adopters.

## 🐛 Fixed

- `reference/tokens.css`'s base `body` rule (background, font stack, letter-spacing) and `* { box-sizing: border-box; }`, dropped during the original extraction from KnightLoader's `index.css`, are back — an app following the adoption steps literally now gets the page-level defaults, not just the component classes.
- `.glim-live`'s pulse now has a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback (renders as a static, fully-opaque dot instead of continuing to pulse) — an infinite 2s animation is exactly the category that preference exists for.
